visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an extreme close-up of circular, textured crackers stacked on a white plate. The crackers are dark brown and appear slightly rough with visible grain textures. The background is a soft, out-of-focus white, creating a clean, professional food photography aesthetic. (2) A pair of hands enters the frame over a light wooden surface. One hand holds a glass bowl filled with large rolled oats, pouring them steadily into a clear plastic blender jar. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the individual flakes as they tumble. (3) The scene shifts to adding wet ingredients into the blender jar. A small glass pitcher pours white low-fat milk, followed by two whole raw eggs with bright yellow yolks. Finally, golden honey is drizzled from a stainless steel spoon into the mixture. (4) A hand attaches a light pink motor unit to the blender jar and pulses it. The camera captures the rapid motion of the blades turning the ingredients into a creamy, thick beige paste. A close-up shows the uniform texture of the resulting batter on a spoon. (5) The batter is transferred into a larger glass mixing bowl. The chef then holds a small glass container of dark cocoa powder and sprinkles it over half of the batter. A spoon is used to vigorously fold the powder in until dark and smooth. (6) Wearing translucent plastic gloves, the chef rolls small portions of the dough into spheres. These are placed on a baking tray lined with white parchment paper. A grey silicone spatula, lightly coated with oil, is used to press each ball into a flat, thin disc. (7) The baking tray is slid into a compact, black and silver Panasonic countertop oven. The camera shows the oven's interior glowing with warm orange light as the crackers begin to brown. The digital display and knobs of the appliance are clearly visible. (8) The video concludes with a medium full shot of the finished crackers. Some are light golden-brown (original) and others are dark chocolate-brown (cocoa). They are stacked neatly on a plate, presented under bright, naturalistic studio lighting to showcase their crispy, baked edges.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a gentle, upbeat acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a soft piano line, establishing a cheerful and domestic atmosphere. A male narrator with a friendly, professional tone begins speaking in Mandarin, introducing the recipe with clear articulation and moderate pitch. (2) As the narrator lists ingredients, the acoustic mix is layered with a distinct rustling and cascading sound of dry oats hitting the plastic container. This is followed by the liquid pour of milk and a sharp, percussive crack as eggshells are broken, creating a textured sonic environment. (3) A sudden mechanical whirring sound of a high-speed blender cuts through the BGM. The sound is consistent and mid-frequency, indicating a powerful motor at work. The narrator's voice is slightly ducked behind this transient sound event, maintaining the focus on the preparation action. (4) The mechanical noise stops, replaced by the rhythmic metallic clicking of a spoon against a glass bowl. These transients are short and bright, occurring as the chef mixes in the cocoa powder. The BGM continues at a steady 120 BPM, providing a constant rhythmic backbone. (5) The sound of rustling parchment paper and the soft, dull thud of a spatula pressing dough into discs are audible. These incidental noises are captured with high fidelity, emphasizing the tactile nature of the cooking process. The narrator maintains a calm, instructional cadence throughout. (6) A metallic click and a short creak signal the opening and closing of an oven door. This is followed by a faint, low-frequency hum of the oven fan. The narrator's tone rises slightly in valence, signaling the approaching completion of the recipe as the music swells. (7) The music reaches a light crescendo as the narrator finishes his sentence. The final few seconds feature the natural decay of the acoustic instruments. The signal-to-noise ratio remains excellent, with all instructional speech clearly discernible over the background elements and sound effects.
